verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤਾ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤ ਮੈ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਤਾਹੀ ਤੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੇਸੁਰ ਹੁਇ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਕਹਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise tau patibrataa patibrat mai saavadhaan taahee te girahesur hui naikaa kahaaviee ||

en.bdb: Just as a loyal and faithful wife is ever conscious of fulfilling her wifely obligations, and that makes her the prime person of the family.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਸਨ ਬਸਨ ਧਨ ਧਾਮ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਪੁਜਾਵੈ ਸੋਭਤਿ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਚਾਰ ਸਿਹਜਾ ਸਮਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: asan basan dhan dhaam kaamanaa pujaavai sobhat si(n)gaar chaar sihajaa samaaviee ||

en.bdb: Her husband fulfils all her needs of bedding, clothing, food, wealth, house and other property, and she in returns embellishes herself to enjoy oneness with her husband on the nuptial bed,

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਖਨ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਤ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਸਤ ਮੈ ਸੰਪਤਾ ਸਮੂਹ ਸੁਖ ਲੁਡੇ ਤੇ ਲਡਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: satigur sikhan kau raakhat girahasat mai sa(n)pataa samooh sukh ludde te laddaaviee ||

en.bdb: Similarly, the True Guru keeps His devoted and obedient Sikhs lovingly in their householders life. With the blessings of ambrosial name of the Lord, he reaches the spiritual peace in their family life.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਸਨ ਬਸਨ ਧਨ ਧਾਮ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ  ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਭਾਉ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਮਿਟਾਵਈ ॥੪੮੧॥
verses.translit_en: asan basan dhan dhaam kaamanaa pavitr  aan dhev sev bhaau dhuteeaa miTaaviee ||481||

en.bdb: In the desire of the sacred name, the True Guru blesses His Sikhs with food, bedding, clothing, mansions and other worldly assets. He removes all their duality of serving and following other gods and goddesses.  (481)
